d1.title: Externalised Production & Labour
d1.subtitle: How outsourcing reshapes labour, power and value in Global South supply chains
d1.research_question: How does externalisation affect workers in Global South supply chains, and to what extent does it facilitate labour exploitation?
method: Triangulation across NGO, academic and government sources

d2.title: Unequal Economic & Ecological Relations Across German-led EV Value Chains
d2.subtitle: Following nickel through Volkswagen's EV value chain
d2.research_question: How do relations of environmental expropriation, labour exploitation and capital accumulation vary across German-led electric vehicle value chains?
d2.subquestion: What do these relations tell us about Just Transition?
